additional_info.subject: RE: ID0368041-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2/PN 312562229/08] Converter Issue CRM:00643000785
additional_info.body:
Hi Team,
Greetings of the day!
In relation to this power converter issue. Please follow the below steps for troubleshooting.
1. Checked the converter grouping in the SCB, it looks fine as per the Flex configuration.
2. Please check if the power converter are properly connection to its shelf case.
3. Check for any loose connection of any power cable or CAN communication cables of the converter and measured the voltage across it with the help of multimeter. Check the resistance across CAN communication cables.
4. Please see to the display of the power converter whether it is OFF state or ON?
5. Try swapping the power converter with the good one and if the error flag was changed to the replaced one then we can suspect that the converter is faulty.
6. If all the steps are performed and you still see the power converter are faulty, we suggest you to replace it as we can't rework to it.
